planDescription: Platinum Optimizer gaming power plan. Responsive on AC power, thermally and battery aware on DC. Created and managed with powercfg; existing user plans are never deleted.
policy: The automatic mode duplicates the currently active Windows scheme (Balanced as a safe fallback), reuses an existing exact-name plan, and changes only a small documented processor policy set. Core parking, boost, PCIe/USB, display, sleep, network and driver settings remain unchanged unless a future verified workload-specific feature is explicitly added. Every applied power setting is read back.

settings.name: Minimum processor state
settings.notes: Floor for the processor performance state. 100 forces maximum clock at all times (more heat and idle power); small values let Windows idle down.

settings.name: Maximum processor state
settings.notes: Ceiling for the processor performance state. On many Intel systems a value below 100 also disables turbo boost, which trades peak speed for lower heat on battery.

settings.name: System cooling policy
settings.notes: Active cooling favors sustained clocks; passive favors quietness and may reduce clocks earlier.

settings.name: Processor performance boost policy
settings.notes: Documented boost engagement level; reported as 'Processor performance boost mode' on some AMD systems. Not present on every platform, so it is applied only when the system exposes it.

settings.name: Processor performance core parking max cores
settings.notes: Upper bound on cores the scheduler may use. Documented core-parking setting; hidden or absent on systems where Windows manages parking internally.

settings.name: Processor performance core parking min cores
settings.notes: Lower bound on unparked cores. 100 keeps every core unparked (responsive, higher idle power). Lower values let Windows park cores at idle.

settings.name: Processor performance core parking utility distribution
settings.notes: Distributes work across cores to avoid concentrating heat; document setting, skipped when the platform does not expose it.

settings.name: PCI Express Link State Power Management
settings.notes: Off avoids link-power-state transitions on AC gaming; moderate on battery keeps power draw reasonable.

settings.name: USB selective suspend setting
settings.notes: Disabled on AC keeps USB headsets/controllers from being suspended; kept enabled on battery to preserve runtime.

settings.name: Sleep after
settings.notes: Idle timeout before normal system sleep. The Platinum plan keeps normal sleep functional instead of disabling it.

settings.name: Turn off display after
settings.notes: Idle timeout before the display powers down.

presets.name: Platinum On Steroids — Gaming
presets.description: Conservative automatic desktop profile. Keeps the processor minimum low for idle efficiency, permits the documented 100 percent maximum on AC, and requests active cooling on AC. Unspecified settings remain copied from the active Windows plan.

presets.name: Platinum On Steroids — Responsive
presets.description: Compatibility alias for the conservative gaming profile. It does not pin minimum clocks, disable core parking, or force boost behavior.

presets.name: Platinum On Steroids — Balanced
presets.description: Conservative everyday profile. Preserves the active plan as its base, keeps the processor minimum low, allows full maximum headroom, and leaves unspecified AC/DC values unchanged.

presets.name: Platinum On Steroids — Laptop
presets.description: Portable profile. On AC it uses the conservative gaming values; on battery it caps maximum processor state at 85 percent while leaving other OEM power, sleep, cooling, USB, and display choices unchanged. Battery performance can be lower by design.

restorePreset.name: Restore Previous Power Plan
restorePreset.description: Reactivates the plan that was active before Platinum On Steroids was activated. The Platinum plan itself is kept so it can be re-selected; no user plan is ever deleted automatically.
